projectTitle: Servers Are Up Cloud API, MCP & CLI
description: Public REST API v1, OpenAPI 3.1 contract, hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server (/api/mcp/v1), sau CLI, ephemeral Ed25519 SSH leases, and runnable recipes for Servers Are Up.
rules: Prefer hosted Streamable HTTP MCP (https://serversareup.com/api/mcp/v1) or bearer sau_ tokens generated at https://serversareup.com/account/api-keys over static root SSH keys.
Always query GET /api/v1/catalog for live product pricing and availability before quoting SKUs.
Always pass a deterministic Idempotency-Key header on mutating POST or DELETE orders.
